```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## Storm Frequency Over Time

The `storms` dataset contains data on tropical cyclones from 1975 to 2022. Below is a visualization of the number of unique named storms recorded each year.

```{r storm-plot}
storms |> 
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |> 
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("hurricane", "tropical storm", "tropical depression"))) |> 
  group_by(year, status) |> 
  summarise(n_storms = n_distinct(name), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Storm Frequency by Type (1975-2022)",
    subtitle = "Stacked count of unique named storms per year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count of Unique Names",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

## Wind Speed Distribution by Category

This plot shows how wind speeds vary across different storm categories.

```{r wind-boxplot}
storms |>
  filter(!is.na(category)) |> 
  mutate(category = as.factor(category)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = wind, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Wind Speed Distribution across Hurricane Categories",
    subtitle = "Higher category storms exhibit significantly higher median wind speeds",
    x = "Hurricane Category",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)"
  )
```
